translation_notes: OWL_NS = Namespace(...) absorbed into '@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .'; RDF.type -> rdf:type, OWL_NS.Class -> owl:Class, both in keyword-argument position (operand context, so the island is recognised)

the mechanical draft named the prefix after the Python variable (owl-ns:) and inserted the @prefix statements inside the parenthesised 'from rdflib import (...)' list; both were fixed by hand -- a hyphenated prefix is usable inside g{} islands only, never in expression position, so a Python-identifier prefix name is mandatory here
the 'from rdflib import (...)' preamble is left untouched even though RDF/Namespace become unused on the ldpy side (the region's other imported names are already unused in the extract)
